column1: # Unreal Engine 5: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB engine address region and FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it.
# The rewriter's engine-wide gates (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py and dm/tools/ue_region.py) replace FMallocBinned3 with
# the host allocator and size the engine region to what the alias region has room for; stdalloc_cap caps the SDK's
# StandardAllocator region at 2 GB so both fit inside the 6 GB alias region on iOS.
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
